title: Trader Diary: The 1‑Minute Chart Stare
content:
📈 Spot price up 0.8% → I open a 10x futures position.
🚀 5 seconds later: "I’m a genius!" 
⏳ 1 minute later: "Why is my margin screaming?" 
💤 3 AM: "Just one more candle..."
lesson: Never let a single candle dictate a 10x move – set stop‑losses before the hype hits.
question: Who’s still glued to the 1‑minute chart at 3 AM? Drop your latest panic‑buy story 👇
